title: POL-156: policy governing the Ledger Core
body:
SCOPE:

The policy below governs use of the Ledger Core; it is out for comment. Tomas Lindqvist of Data
Services is the policy owner, and Bluegate Networks audits compliance each year against the controls
listed here.

REQUIREMENTS:

As of the 19 March 2025 review the requirements are:
* Report a suspected security incident within one hour of noticing it
* Document every manual change in the shared change log
* Obtain written sign-off before granting vendor access

STATUS:

Status of this policy: in draft. Issued by Hana Kowalski on 12 September 2025; 40 exceptions are on
file with Data Services and expire at the yearly audit.
